MWI.note: Document describes a roaming initiative and operator agreements, not shared law taken into national law.

facts.fact: ZICTA says operators in the One Network Area, which includes Malawi, cut roaming tariffs by 3 to 93 percent and signed new bilateral roaming agreements.
ZICTA says operators in the One Network Area, which includes Zambia, cut roaming tariffs by 3 to 93 percent and signed new bilateral roaming agreements.
